name: Admin Accounting History — Read and Retry a Send
description: Superuser diagnoses a send from its own row in the Envíos subtab. The row's leading three-dots menu opens the message as it was delivered (GET accounting/email-log/<id>/body/, rendered in a sandboxed iframe via srcdoc like the branded-email composer); sends predating the feature say so instead of opening an empty modal. A failed send is retried from the row menu (POST accounting/email-log/<id>/retry/), reaching only the address on that row — the other recipients already got their copy. Only the notices tied to a single record (cambio contable, cuenta de cobro, pago de hosting) are retryable; the three digests show the menu entry disabled carrying the reason, because re-running one would build today's summary rather than the message that failed. The disabled entry keeps its reason visible under its label, and opening the menu never expands the row. The retry lands as a new log row linked to the original through retry_of, so both attempts stay visible, and a retry that fails again reports its cause. The expanded row also names the records the email was about (EmailLogTarget).
